notes.title: Balancing Update
notes.content: Adjusted common Monster XP. It is harder to get to level 3 now by beating 2 common monsters.

notes.title: Improve Starting fort selection
notes.content: Improved the selection of starting forts in procedural map games. Now it prioritizes being close to a monster.

notes.title: Minor Bug Fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed Swift Step bug that allowed double skill
- Fixed Fireball not creating aggro
- improved spawn location logic

Thanks to Minator for the reports!

notes.title: Expansion Items
notes.content: Added the expansion items (some of them have placeholder art)

notes.title: Expansion factions added
notes.content:
